docs.title: BRG framework
docs.text:
BRG framework installs the Block Research Group packages in one step. It builds on the COMPAS framework, which is installed with it. Code written with BRG framework follows the COMPAS agent guides.

See Installation and the list of Packages.

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text:
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• Documentation site at https://blockresearchgroup.github.io/brg_framework/ (MkDocs Material): installation with the supported Python versions, the list of packages, contributing, release, changelog and license.
  • Agent guidance that follows the COMPAS framework (c3-upgrade): links to its AGENTS.md, agents, skills and initiatives, and a workflow section in AGENTS.md and the brg-methods skill (investigate, design and stop for approval, implement, review).
  • initiatives/ with the handoff and decision templates, in the compas_framework layout, and the first initiative, compas-3-compatibility (proposed, not implemented).
  • Development tooling: invoke tasks (test, lint, format, typecheck, release, prepare-changelog), pyright type check, and the bump-my-version configuration.
  • GitHub templates: code of conduct, issue and pull request templates, and a changelog check on pull requests.

docs.title: Changed
docs.text:
• CI follows the compas_framework workflows: actions pinned to commit SHAs, read-only permissions, concurrency, ruff format --check and pyright, and tests on Python 3.10 to 3.13 on Linux, macOS and Windows.
  • Release: the package is built once, checked (twine check, clean wheel smoke test, tag equals version), then the same files are published to PyPI with trusted publishing and attached to the GitHub release.
  • Docs are built in strict mode on pull requests and deployed from main.
  • Fixed the types in brg_framework.cli.

docs.title: Changed
docs.text: • The brg-methods skill tells agents to follow the COMPAS framework guidelines (compas_framework).

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• brg_framework package: installs compas_framework, then compas_fd, compas_dr, compas_tna, compas_tno, compas_dem, compas_ags and compas_viewer.
  • brg command: brg install, brg examples, brg copy <name>, brg version.
  • The brg-methods skill ships inside the package.

docs.title: Contributing
docs.text:
Install uv, clone the repository and install the development tools:

uv sync --extra dev

Run the checks before you push:

uv run ruff check .
uv run ruff format --check .
uv run pyright
uv run pytest -q

The same checks run in CI. Each is also a task: uv run invoke test, lint, format, typecheck.

Rules for agents and people are in AGENTS.md. They follow the COMPAS framework guidelines.

Add a line to the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md with every change.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
BRG framework supports Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13.

pip install brg_framework

This installs the packages listed on the Packages page and the brg command.

brg --help

docs.title: Release
docs.text:
1. Add the changes to the Unreleased section of CHANGELOG.md.
  2. Commit everything and push to main. Wait for the build workflow to pass.
  3. Run, in a terminal:
uv run invoke release patch

Use minor or major when the version needs it. The task formats, tests, bumps the version, tags it, builds the package and prepares the next Unreleased section. 4. Push the commits and the tag:

git push --tags && git push

The v* tag starts the release workflow. It tests the package, publishes it to PyPI with trusted publishing (environment pypi) and creates the GitHub release.
